name: Look up a member by number or last name
description:
Sign on to MERIDIAN CORE as the given operator. The member lookup screen supports searching either by member number or by last name; search using the given member number, since it is the unambiguous identifier, and open that member's record. Read back the member's full name and status as shown on the record screen.

Returns: member_name — Full name shown on the member record., member_status — Status shown on the member record (e.g. active).. Possible business outcomes: member_not_found.
